clause: Raster export touchpoints: web-slice, artboard export paths, per-layer export markers, placed-asset export [STU-RAS-042]

scope.summary: Implement ONLY the 14.4-owned raster-side export touchpoints (the full export/format matrix is 14.13, StudioExportRecipe): a web-slice tool producing independently exportable canvas regions with per-slice name/URL/type; artboard-scoped export paths (from MT-022); per-layer/per-group export markers via layer tags (MT-025); and export of a placed_asset container's embedded source back to a standalone file (touchpoint to MT-029). Route all through the single StudioExportRecipe surface; do not fork export.
acceptance_criteria: web-slice, artboard export paths, per-layer export markers, placed-asset export
all route through the single StudioExportRecipe surface
proof_targets: web-slice + layer-marker export runtime via StudioExportRecipe
expected_tests: live: draw web slices with per-slice name/URL/type and export each region to a Handshake-managed path via StudioExportRecipe; export a tagged layer via its export marker
live: export a placed_asset's embedded source to a standalone file
test: routes through StudioExportRecipe (no forked export path)

risk_if_missed: No slice/artboard/layer-marker export; asset-generation workflows blocked; export forked from 14.13.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
